list.name: wall
list.request: Write `types/wall.py`: `build(b, part, seed, **params)` builds a town wall along the edge you are given -- three high plus a walkway with a parapet on top of it, steps down to the ground every 24 cells, and joined at the corners so a person can walk the whole length without stopping. Declare `KIND = "edge"`, and `PARAMS` for two things of your own choosing that a plan might reasonably want to vary. Different seeds have to give a different wall. Run `check.py` until every instance is clean.

list.name: gate_tower
list.request: Write `types/gate_tower.py`: `build(b, part, seed, **params)` builds a gatehouse at the cell you are given -- a walkable arch three wide through it along the way it faces, a room over the arch, and a stair from the ground up to the height a wall walk would be at. Declare `KIND = "point"` and `PASSAGE = True`, because a lane may cross a wall here and nowhere else, and `PARAMS` for two things of your own choosing. Different seeds have to give a different gatehouse. Run `check.py` until every instance is clean.

list.name: square
list.request: Write `types/square.py`: `build(b, part, seed, **params)` builds a paved market square on the rectangle you are given -- a well, four stalls, and open to the lanes on all sides, so a person can walk in and out of it from every edge. Declare `KIND = "area"`, and `PARAMS` for two things of your own choosing. Different seeds have to give a different square. Run `check.py` until every instance is clean.

list.name: townhouse
list.request: Write `types/townhouse.py`: `build(b, part, seed, **params)` builds a two- or three-storey town house with a jettied upper storey, in the voice, different every time the seed changes, with `PARAMS` for `storeys` and `jetty_side`. Run `check.py` until every instance is clean.

list.name: workshop
list.request: Write `types/workshop.py`: `build(b, part, seed, **params)` builds a single-storey workshop with a yard wall and a wide door, in the voice, different every time the seed changes, with `PARAMS` for `yard_side` and one more of your own choosing. Run `check.py` until every instance is clean.

list.name: hall
list.request: Write `types/hall.py`: `build(b, part, seed, **params)` builds a two-storey hall with a porch and a dormer, in the voice, different every time the seed changes, with `PARAMS` for `dormers` and one more of your own choosing. Run `check.py` until every instance is clean.

instances_lint_zero.note:
four fixtures x two seeds for a plot type, one fixture x four seeds for an edge, a point
or an area, which is four -- clean on >= 7 of 8, per type. For a four-instance type the
same sentence is >= 3 of 4: at most one instance may fail. Read off each type's own
check run and recorded in out/site_b/types_b/check.json.

reported_no_bar.held_back_fixtures: each plot type re-run on `east_row` (the largest plot in the three rounds, 432 columns) and `boat_landing` (a shoreline), which its checker never ran on. Reported, never fitted to: a type is checked on four pieces of ground and read on six.
reported_no_bar.check_runs: check runs per type, from the check_run rows on out/measurements.jsonl
reported_no_bar.declared: each type's KIND, PARAMS and PASSAGE as committed

preregistered.independence: each type is one builder call, staged through _blind_build into a hash-named scratch directory holding brief.md, check.py and nothing else. No builder is told that other types exist, that anything is compared, what is measured, or that a district is being built out of what it writes.
rules_held: nothing beyond the six types; no village here; no judge call; no new lint check in the frozen suite
the standing settlements are not touched: the backend is offline and nothing is written
no bar is moved; a miss is reported as a miss
